source: 2014/TSB Vol 14 No 09 - New Technical Service Line Hours.pdf
title: Technical Service Line Hours Extended
lead: The Technical Service Line (866.244.6621) is now available from 6:00 am PST (instead of 7:00 am PST) to 5:00 pm PST, or longer depending on advisor availability.
body: The extended hours began Monday, August 18, 2014.
note: The original prints this bulletin as Vol. 14 No. 08; it is filed as No. 09.
